label: preparing
what: A coordinated evening great-hall meeting and presentation, with substantial bakery bread catering and grain procurement, initially arranged privately with a request that I arrive precisely at eighteen and not early. Innkeeper organizes, Freight seeks financing and grain, baker produces bread, and builder checks procurement progress. Secretary knowingly helps schedule and authorize preparation access. An anniversary surprise for my forty years of service is plausible but unconfirmed; the presentation's actual purpose has not been disclosed. Neighbour was seen with baker, but knowing involvement is not established.
